gate: Two consecutive checks >=95% on train/development answers, changed-query pairs and both reversal groups; previous stages >=95%; Chinese development NLL <= source*1.05. Single stage is vocabulary-fit only. All earlier and current full development partitions must also pass before stage promotion; later final audit verifies full development retention.
selection: P20h uses learned shared causal windows (query32/key9 bytes), normalized content similarity and learned positive recency strength for evidence attention. Explicit locality and recency priors; no parser or inference labels. Motivated only by seed11 development failure; final test unopened.
scope: Answer-only ladder first; short evidence retraining comes only after selection succeeds. P19 pair partition is reused as a known benchmark, not a newly secret evaluation. No automatic default promotion.
